scope: Reusable Rust host lifetime supervisor and real Bionic original-property worker across inherited Unix channel; diagnostic integration only, no complete runtime/APK acceptance

implementation.decision: Reuse core module and existing compositor ownership patterns; existing shell Supervisor remains shell/Wayland-specific. No JNI/glibc-Bionic in-process bridge or duplicate shell manager.

mechanism: Inherited Unix capability FD, made CLOEXEC inside native worker; strict versioned bounded status/STOP/STOPPED frames
Rust owns Child plus pidfd; mode-specific startup acknowledgment; stop requires ACK and successful actual exit
Unexpected mode/EOF/oversized frame/timeouts and nonzero exit are errors; Drop kills/reaps owned direct child
Command consumed by spawn, so saved pre_exec descriptor closure cannot be reused on a second launch
Native worker runs original patched property/actions/load/close; normal mode checks active enforcing SELinux/context, diagnostic mode explicit and separately acknowledged
Root namespace wrapper uses unshare --kill-child; host example clears child environment except controlled PATH and inherited FD

runtime.normal_native_exit_code: 78 from source; host capture observes refusal log and UnexpectedEof, not a separately sampled native exit code
runtime.observed: Rust owns real PID/pidfd, accepts Diagnostic startup only, sends STOP, native original workers/actions close, acknowledgment then actual exit0. Normal host mode gets no startup acknowledgment on inactive SELinux.
runtime.artifact_binding_limit: Post-run source/prepared-copy hashes and declared paths, not atomic kernel image binding; MCP executable identity is sudo wrapper.

limits: No compositor service integration or finished service/control backend, automatic restart policy, installation or upgrade/rollback accepted
Normal SELinux guard is prerequisite only, not policy/labels/SID or R1-MAC certification
Diagnostic worker is privileged initializer, not app isolation or permission-aware app write acceptance
NativeProcess is not sandbox, descendant manager or arbitrary command authorization; caller owns identities/namespaces/env policy
Protocol/pidfd deadlines do not bound forced kill/reap under uninterruptible kernel I/O; full watchdog/recovery still required
No queues under active persistence/restorecon fault, Binder manager, Composer/Smithay presentation or APK stage accepted
MCP observation/environment/process/filesystem/image limitations preserved; derived reports are not complete authenticated Evidence
ARM translation and external/proprietary API compatibility remain separate unresolved axes
next: Integrate real Linux service/control backend and restart/deadline recovery using this host/native boundary, verify installation/profile prerequisites without boot changes, then resume original managers→Composer→Smithay→complete Markor journey. R1-MAC gate stays explicit.
